subject: Capacity acceleration request + term extension — Q3 usage snapshot
messages:
From: Elliot Smith <elliot@synapse.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 spike — capacity acceleration & short term term extension

Hi Grace,

Quick note — over the last 10 days we’ve seen a sustained 3x spike in model-led product flows tied to a marketing test. Traffic is durable and is expected to remain 2x baseline into Q4. We’re currently bumping into rate limits and KV cache churn (latency spikes ~120ms p95 on some routes).

As a stopgap we need two things:
- A temporary capacity acceleration (roughly 2x current reserved throughput) starting immediately, and
- A short-term (6 month) extension to our renewal so we can align with our fiscal calendar while we evaluate commit levels.

Can you put together: 
1) a short ROI recap showing token economics and projected cost per 1M tokens at 2x capacity,
2) a proposed pricing / term option (commit vs burst) and timing for activation, and
3) answers on audit logs & data residency questions (our security team will ask).

Attaching a screenshot of our Q3 dashboard for context.

Thanks — appreciate a quick turnaround.

— Elliot
Head of Product, Synapse.ai

Attachment: synapse-q3-traffic-dashboard.png
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Smith <elliot@synapse.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 spike — capacity acceleration & short term term extension

Elliot — thanks for the heads up and the dashboard. We can absolutely support an acceleration window and draft a short extension. Quick clarifying Qs so we model the right options:

- Peak RPS during the spike (if you have a number or sample 15-min window)
- Percent of traffic that’s latency-sensitive vs background (helps with routing and SLA tiers)
- Any compliance controls that must remain enforced (e.g., EU-only processing, separate logs)

I’ve looped in Marissa (account lead) for commercial options and Karthik for technical playbook (KV cache/batching). We’ll pull together a compact ROI recap + two commercial options by EOD Friday and propose a kickoff call for Thursday morning.

Call windows that work for us: Thu 9–11am PT or Thu 3–5pm PT. Which is best for you?

Best,
Grace
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0142
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Q3 spike — capacity acceleration & short term term extension

Grace / Karthik — draft commercial proposals below (will attach formal PDF):

Option A — Commit expansion (preferred):
- 2x committed capacity for a 12-month period, billed monthly.
- 15% discount on per-token list below current committed rate.
- Includes priority routing and elevated concurrency limits.
- SLA uplift: p95 latency target tightened by 10ms for the elevated routes.
- Activation window: 48 hours after signed amendment and PO.

Option B — Interim burst + short extension:
- 3-month burst credit pool (pre-purchased token bucket) sufficient for projected Q3/Q4 spikes.
- Short 6-month extension to existing term to align renewal cadence.
- No long-term commitment; higher unit price than Option A but faster activation (within 4 hours).

Notes:
- We should highlight the cache / batching playbook to reduce token spend (Karthik — can you include expected token reduction % with KV caching + batching?).
- Attachments: redwood-proposal-capacity-2x-v1.pdf (commercial), usage-econ-q3.xlsx (detailed math), redwood-sla-addendum.docx (SLA language).

Happy to tighten margins if they push for a 12-month commit; would need an internal approval path for >20% discount.

— Marissa
Senior AM, Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — procurement questions before we proceed: 
1) Can you confirm data residency for logs and audit exports (we require US-only for this workload).
2) Any change to retention windows for audit logs under Option A vs B?
3) Preferred billing terms and whether you accept a 45-day PO (we typically do 30–60 day PO).

Also looping legal (contracts@) — please send a clean redline for the amendment + SLA addendum. We’re aiming to have a PO by 45 days if commercial terms are agreed.

— Synapse.ai Procurement (on behalf of Synapse.ai)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Synapse.ai Procurement <contracts@synapse.ai>, Elliot Smith <elliot@synapse.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Redwood proposal & ROI recap — Synapse Q3 capacity options

Hi Ava / team — attaching the formal proposal and the ROI math. High-level answers inline: 

- Data residency: logs and audit exports for your account can be configured for US-only export. We’ll include the residency clause in the amendment.
- Retention: default audit log retention remains unchanged; for Option A we can offer extended retention (90 days) as an add-on.
- Billing: we accept a 45-day PO; standard activation requires PO + signed amendment for Option A (48 hours).

ROI highlights (summary):
- Current blended cost: $45 per 1M tokens (baseline).
- Option A projected blended cost: $34 per 1M tokens (2x commit, 15% discount + volume tiers).
- Option B blended cost (burst credits): $52 per 1M tokens for the burst tokens (short-term premium).
- With KV caching + 200ms batching window applied to the heavy route, expected token reduction: ~18–24% (Karthik to confirm exact).

Attachments: redwood-proposal-capacity-2x-v1.pdf, usage-econ-q3.xlsx, redwood-sla-addendum.docx

Next steps:
1) Internal signoff on commercial option (Synapse)
2) Redwood sends amendment + redline to contracts@
3) PO issued — we activate per chosen option

Proposed times for a quick legal/commercial sync: Tue 9am PT or Wed 11am PT.

Thanks — will follow up with a short slide that visualizes token economics for the execs.

Best,
Grace

(Attachment: redwood-proposal-capacity-2x-v1.pdf)

Thanks Grace — this looks good. We’re inclined toward Option A (2x commit) pending legal review. Procurement confirms 45-day PO window is fine.

Can you send a calendar invite for the legal/commercial sync on Tue 9am PT and include the redline? Also, small ask — can we get a one-page execution checklist (what we need to sign / PO / timing) so our finance team can queue the PO?

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the ROI summary — the numbers make the case cleanly.

— Elliot
